parent_acceptance_gate: Run this pair only after H02-var01-primary-lru-damage-v1.0.0 is accepted and merged to simlox/main; until then the source is a reviewed PR candidate, not an accepted parent.

direct_parent.scope: one primary TEACH-LRU-01 with local spare and ItemRepair, certain in-flight BATTLE-HIT with PROB1, REPF1 and explicit local DamageReplacement, three fixed missions, seed1, horizon36

manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp193,426-427: DamageItem.REPF overrides the default discard behavior for damaged items; without repairability, a damaged LRU is discarded after removal at base and nominal stock is permanently reduced. An item TYPE or configured ordinary ItemRepair alone does not imply damaged-item repairability.
source_delta: The repairable arm is byte-identical to the accepted H02.var01 primary-LRU source. The child changes only DamageItem.REPF from 1 to 0 and ProblemDescription. Both preserve DAMP1, PROB1, directly mounted LRU, one BASE-01 spare, explicit DamageReplacement, ordinary ItemRepair, three fixed scheduled missions, seed1 and horizon36.

pre_run_hypotheses.repairable: The byte-identical parent should again show primary-LRU damage, local spare issue, system replacement, one-hour repair of each removed LRU and return to stock, permitting later launches.
pre_run_hypotheses.discard: At least the first BATTLE-HIT should damage the mounted LRU, issue the one local spare to restore the aircraft, then discard the removed damaged LRU rather than running the configured one-hour ItemRepair. The physical and nominal local stock should not be restored by this discarded item; later shortage and sortie effects must be read from native events and bins, not assumed from the process exit.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, no item-identified damage, repair despite REPF0, an unlogged replacement, or nominal stock unchanged without a compensating stock transaction are diagnostic only. Event times and later mission count are not preaccepted.

acceptance_gates: Accepted and merged direct parent plus independent pre-run static review of frozen sources, exact diff, manual/dictionary basis and guarded runner
Two fresh serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
Exact 24/24 authored row-containing table roundtrips and zero converter errors with valid native logs/reports

Positive REPF1 repair/stock return versus REPF0 discard/nominal-stock-loss contrast with individual item IDs, physical stock ledger, later mission status and 72-bin System/Stock/ResultSummary reconciliation
SHA-256 sealed raw evidence and independent read-only post-run replay
limits: This pair tests REPF endpoints 1 and 0 for one fixed seed and one primary LRU; an intermediate REPF value, statistical repair fraction, damaged subitems and multiple consequences remain unverified.

The explicit DamageReplacement and ordinary ItemRepair rows are retained across arms; this pair does not test general repair-data fallback priority, other stations, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
